# Hickman Design

> Hickman Design is a UK-based art-supply retailer and printmaking resource hub.  
> We stock 2 000 + products, publish in-depth printmaking guides, maintain a public portfolio and offer calculators for pricing artwork.  
> Our goal is to help artists turn craft into livelihood while promoting low-waste studio practice.

Hickman Design is fully independent and based in Colchester, Essex.  

## Important pages

- [Home](https://hickmandesign.co.uk/)  
- [Shop root](https://hickmandesign.co.uk/buy/)
